_comment: obs-macro-pad key map (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-obs-macro-pad.md §4). device = the pad's full by-id name up to its -event-* suffix (ls -l /dev/input/by-id); vendor/product = its usb id (lsusb), checked on every grab; keys = evdev key name -> verb. install.sh copies this to ~/.config/obs-macro-pad/map.json once; edit that copy.
